landing.title: Advertise with us
landing.subtitle: Reach Maheshwari families and businesses across Bengaluru.
landing.ctaReadyBody: Request a placement or check how your ads are doing.
landing.ctaHeadBody: As head of family you can enable advertising with one tap.
landing.ctaOtherBody: Advertising is managed by the head of the family. A business that is not a member can sign up separately.
landing.b1b: Your ad is seen by verified Maheshwari member families.
landing.b2b: Every ad carries an AD tag, so members trust the directory.
landing.b3b: Members can call or message you with one tap from your ad.
landing.b4b: See impressions, viewers and taps for your own ads.
landing.placementsHint: Pick where your ad appears. Sizes are in pixels; rates are for the whole period.
landing.s1b: Choose a placement and a plan.
landing.s2b: Add your ad using the sizing guide.
landing.s3b: Pay by UPI; the Sabha reviews your ad.
